facts.programme_association: Bachelor meets Business - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: QTEM (Quantitative Techniques for Economics and Management) is a growing international network of leading universities worldwide, supported by international corporate partners. The corporate partner of the department in the QTEM network is Banco Santander.
The QTEM programme includes one or two semesters abroad and an internship. Its goal is to deepen analytical and quantitative skills.
QTEM Track 1: 1 semester abroad + an internship of 240 hours; QTEM Track 2: 2 semesters abroad + an internship of 240 hours.

All QTEM students participate in the QTEM Global Business Analytics Challenge (GBAC, 8 ECTS), which consists of a group project on a business case and two preparatory courses that teach soft skills necessary for successful teamwork and case handling.
A total of 50 ECTS credits in quantitative courses must be earned, with 22 ECTS credits required for each semester abroad at one of the QTEM partner universities.
The master's thesis is written at the home university in Frankfurt.
Upon successful completion of the QTEM programme and the master's degree from the department, students receive the master's degree from the department and a QTEM certificate.

A mandatory requirement for participation in the QTEM programme is proof of a GMAT test result of at least 555 points or an equivalent GRE result (e.g., 155 in Verbal Reasoning and 159 in Quantitative Reasoning).
As of the fourth quarter of 2024, a new GMAT test format will be introduced. The previous format will still be accepted, with a minimum score of 600 required.
The QTEM exchange takes place in the 3rd and/or 4th semester.

Students in the first semester of the master's programmes in Business Administration (BWL), Management Science (Mgmt Sc.), Money, Macro and Finance (MMF), and International Economics and Economic Policy (MIEEP) can apply.
The application deadline for the academic year 2026/27 is February 1, 2026.
The new announcements will be published at the end of October, with the application deadline being February 1 of the following year.

QTEM partner universities in Europe include EDHEC Business School, Lille, France; Université Paris Dauphine, France; LUISS, Rome, Italy; Politecnico di Milano, Italy; DCC Business School, Dublin, UK; Exeter Business School, UK.

QTEM partner universities worldwide include Xiamen University, China; Zhejiang University, Hangzhou, China; Harbin Institute of Technology, China; International Business School Suzhou, Xi'an Jiatong-Liverpool University, China.
